dict.Cheltuielile de protocol se scad din pro: Entertainment expenses are deducted from profit only up to 2% of the difference between taxable income and its expenses, excluding profit tax and the entertainment expenses themselves; the rest is non-deductible.
dict.Limita contează doar la impozitul pe pro: The limit only matters for profit tax; check the calculation and the VAT on entertainment expenses with your accountant.
dict.Mesele de afaceri, cadourile și gustăril: Business meals, gifts and snacks for partners, with the document, the occasion and the VAT; from the year-to-date income and expenses you get the 2% deductible limit, how much is deducted from profit and how much is non-deductible: within limit (green) or over limit (red), with the total by type of expense.
dict.Pe fiecare factură sau bon păstrați scop: On each invoice or receipt keep the purpose: with which partner, at which meeting or occasion; small gifts for partners are also entered here.
dict.Justificarea unei mese de afaceri, a uno: Justification of a business meal, gifts or snacks for partners: the partner, the occasion, the attendees and the purpose of the meeting, the documents with the value and the VAT, the total, who paid and the administrator’s approval
